import { defineConfig } from "@gleanwork/pluginpack";
import type {
  Artifact,
  Author,
  BuildOptions,
  Citation,
  CleanupEntry,
  CleanupResult,
  DiffEntry,
  DiffResult,
  EmittedPluginConfig,
  FileValue,
  InstallParams,
  InstallSnippet,
  Metadata,
  PluginpackConfig,
  ResolvedPluginpackConfig,
  ResolvedProject,
  SourcePlugin,
  TargetConfig,
  TargetName,
  ValidationIssue,
  ValidationResult,
} from "@gleanwork/pluginpack";

// A tuple keeps every imported type in the checked consumer surface.
export type PublicTypes = [
  Artifact, Author, BuildOptions, Citation, CleanupEntry, CleanupResult,
  DiffEntry, DiffResult, EmittedPluginConfig, FileValue, InstallParams,
  InstallSnippet, Metadata, PluginpackConfig, ResolvedPluginpackConfig,
  ResolvedProject, SourcePlugin, TargetConfig, TargetName, ValidationIssue,
  ValidationResult,
];

const config: PluginpackConfig = { name: "consumer", version: "1.0.0", targets: {} };
defineConfig(config);
export const binaryFile: FileValue = new Uint8Array([65, 66]);
export const files: Artifact["files"] = new Map([["asset.bin", binaryFile]]);
